title: Fix Telegram callback action-token classification
requirements: Classify callback action by the complete colon-delimited token after v1:, never by string prefix. Only exact action tokens o, h, r, u and s are known. A known token with missing or extra fields remains MALFORMED_CALLBACK; an empty token remains MALFORMED_CALLBACK. Any other complete token, including other, help, reset, submit, service, oops, h2, r0, u_ and x with or without following fields, is UNSUPPORTED_CALLBACK. Unknown protocol versions remain UNSUPPORTED_CALLBACK.

Keep all TG-005 validation, canonical service parsing, immutability and safe errors unchanged. Add direct parameterized regression assertions for every unknown token sharing a valid token's first character, known-token malformed forms, empty token and unknown versions. Prove no KeyError or other implementation exception escapes.

Copy this exact contract from primary .pipeline/TG-006-spec.json to tasks/specs/TG-006.json. Do not change any other behavior or add conversation, catalog resolution, transport, copy, HTTP, SDK, persistence, environment, logging, delivery, retry or external calls.
acceptance: Callback classification follows complete grammar tokens, so unknown actions cannot be mislabeled based on their first character.
All focused interaction, Telegram update regression, complete project, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Narrow grammar repair required before the Telegram intent protocol can be used by orchestration.
